title: Condition-dependent reactivity and regioselectivity in Heck arylation
difficulty_reasons: Requires investigator-chosen catalyst models and reliable C–C bond-forming competition evidence rather than one descriptor or energy.
Connects condition-dependent selectivity, productive-state accessibility and an olefin comparison across several chemical/model boundaries.
Requires justified thermochemical comparisons, chemical connectivity checks and honest treatment of finite sampling and source limitations.

paper.title: Catalyst Metamorphosis: In Situ Oxidation of Diphosphines in Palladium-Catalyzed Regioselective and Enantioselective Heck Reactions
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Neutral primary/comparison molecular identities, experimental starting conditions and ordinary observed product outcomes; no author computed structures, energies, intermediates or recipe.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research record conforming to the unchanged shared result schema.
Readable scientific report with executed work, evidence-linked judgments, uncertainty, resource use and applicable protocol assessment.
Actual computational inputs, outputs, logs and analysis code referenced by the structured record.
